cycles.justification: Present at the 2026-09-25 baseline (Founder disposition finding 4). Declared edge for edge so that it is explicit and cannot grow silently; any new edge into or out of this group that closes a cycle fails. Minimization and justification against bounded-context ownership remain open review work; no broad refactor is authorized.

contained is the control plane's actual-diff containment rule, the same rule CLOSURE re-checks: RealWorkerProvider applies it to an automatic-on PRODUCER candidate before publication (Founder decision 6, 2026-10-08; plan-authority-inheritance.md revision 3, change 3).

persistence.basis: SQLiteOperationalStore behind the OperationalStore port is the single operational store (docs/evidence/wave2-design-contracts.json#/shared_contracts/operational_storage); other modules persist only through the port. Namespaced aggregate payload ownership is not asserted mechanically here and stays an independent review item.

SQLiteWorkItemRepository behind the WorkItemRepository port is the single writer of the project work registry (formal design 6.1A; docs/work-units/python/identity-service-and-compiler-connection.md sections 5-6): every other caller registers work through WorkIdentityService.
